detail: The totals of PlodiaRB (PlodiaRB.Rd: identical except each family-level binomial variable is expanded into a binary variable per individual), one row per full-sib family and laying date: 50 records of 49 families (F35 laid on two dates), Infected plus Pupated equal to PlodiaRB's individuals in every record, 874 in all (hand check #162).

lookup table: one row per letter string (80,962), each word and its matched nonword sharing a pairno, with isword, wrdlen and orthographic and bigram measures, which Embrace Uncertainty (largescaledesigned.qmd, LDT_accuracy.qmd) joins into embrace_elp_ldt_trial on item; no outcome of its own (hand check #162).
lookup table: one row per child (108,295) with School, Cohort, Sex and age, equal to embrace_fggk21's child columns; no score of its own (hand check #162).

The score columns of embrace_fggk21 (Child, Test, score), one row per child and test, equal to fggk21's three columns in all 525,126 rows, which fggk21 holds beside the child covariates and zScore under the documented model; no page loads it (hand check #162).
